status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Pollard (ankle) returned to practice Thursday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com  reports.
status.longComment: After sitting out Wednesday's session due to his ankle issue, Pollard's return is a positive sign for Tennessee's lead running back heading into Week 3 prep. Pollard's availability for Week 3 is particularly important with Tyjae Spears (ankle) not present for the open portion of Thursday's practice. Friday's practice will tell the tale for Pollard's status going into the Titans' matchup with the Giants.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Spears was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury.
status.longComment: The Titans' top two running backs are both managing sore ankles to begin Week 3 prep, as Tony Pollard was also sidelined for Wednesday's session. Head coach Robert Saleh didn't indicate that either back is at major risk of sitting out Sunday's game against the Giants, but Spears will nonetheless need to upgrade to full practice participation by Friday to avoid taking an injury designation into the weekend.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Flott (quadriceps) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
status.longComment: Flott was unable to participate in Friday's practice, causing the starting cornerback to sit out Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Eagles. The 25-year-old is back at practice but will need to upgrade to full participation by Friday's session to avoid any injury designation ahead of the Titans' Week 3 game against the Giants.
